node.title: Comunidades de práctica
node.summary: Share and adapt patterns through practitioners with local judgment.

relations: The China account describes communities proposed and initiated for regional transfer; tacit-knowledge transmission provides a complementary explanation of what such transfer requires.
La fuente no demuestra adopción ni resultados de todas las comunidades; el paper de Tiger Teams no acredita participación en aquellas sesiones.
The community-of-practice idea becomes operational when participants can observe judgment, rehearse it and retain an apprenticeship path for novel exceptions.
La afinidad metodológica no demuestra que toda comunidad o encuentro produzca una capacidad duradera.
The ceramics interview provides a bounded illustration of practice exchange; it does not by itself establish a sustained community or lasting skill transfer.
La entrevista registra una experiencia y propósitos; no contiene una evaluación longitudinal de aprendizaje.
